newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA to get new cargo chief -- SIA source.
newsitem.headline: SIA to get new cargo chief -- SIA source.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd will soon appoint a new director of cargo operations in a routine staff reshuffle, an SIA source said on Tuesday.
The source said Hwang Teng Aun, now senior vice president of North Asia, would replace Huang Cheng Eng in the top job.
Huang, who has been the cargo chief since the sector was set up in 1988, would become director of marketing planning. The changes will be effective on November 18, the source said.
He said it was routine procedure for SIA management staff to be rotated through the airline's different divisions.
An airline spokesman declined to comment on the upcoming changes.
